title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 5,201–5,250 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 海洋國家的；海事海運的

examples.en: Taiwan's strategic position as a vibrant maritime nation connects East Asian and transpacific shipping lanes.
examples.zh: 台灣作為生機盎然的海洋國家，位處連結東亞航線與橫跨太平洋遠洋貨運的樞紐要道。

examples.en: The university established a new department dedicated to maritime law and international shipping regulations.
examples.zh: 這所大學設立了一個專門研究海事法規與國際航運規範的新系所。

examples.en: Strict maritime safety standards are enforced to prevent oil spills and vessel collisions in coastal waters.
examples.zh: 沿海水域嚴格執行各項海事安全標準，以防止漏油意外與船隻碰撞事故。

words.definition: 國際深水大商港；海港

examples.en: The Port of Kaohsiung ranks among the world's most efficient deep-water seaports for container throughput.
examples.zh: 高雄港名列全球貨櫃裝卸效率最頂尖的現代化深水國際海港之一。

examples.en: Keelung was historically developed as the premier northern seaport connecting Taiwan to global maritime routes.
examples.zh: 基隆在歷史上被開發為台灣北部首要的大商港，串聯起通往全球的海運航線。

examples.en: Customs officials at the seaport inspect thousands of cargo containers every day using high-energy X-ray scanners.
examples.zh: 海港的海關官員每天利用高能 X 光掃描儀，仔細檢驗數以千計的貨櫃。

words.definition: 全球貨櫃化標準運輸革命

examples.en: Global containerization revolutionized international commerce by standardizing cargo boxes across rail and sea.
examples.zh: 全球「貨櫃化運輸」標準化革命，徹底顛覆了現代海運與陸運的多式聯運體系。

examples.en: The widespread adoption of containerization drastically reduced loading times and port labor expenses.
examples.zh: 貨櫃化運輸的普及大幅縮短了碼頭裝卸時間，並顯著降低了港埠人力成本。

examples.en: Modern logistics owes much of its seamless speed to intermodal containerization across trucks and cargo ships.
examples.zh: 現代物流能具備如此順暢的高效速度，很大程度歸功於貨車與貨輪間的複合貨櫃化標準。

words.definition: 兩萬四千 TEU 超大型巨輪

examples.en: Giant 24,000-TEU megaships operated by Taiwanese carriers transport thousands of tons across continents.
examples.zh: 台灣本土遠洋航運巨頭旗下的兩萬四千 TEU 超大型巨輪，乘風破浪航向全球。

examples.en: Accommodating a modern megaship requires deep harbors and high-capacity gantry cranes.
examples.zh: 容納現代超大型巨輪停泊需要極深的水道，以及超大承載量的橋式起重機。

examples.en: The sudden arrival of three megaships created temporary congestion in the terminal's sorting yards.
examples.zh: 三艘超大型巨輪同時抵港，使貨櫃碼頭的理貨調度場出現了短暫擁塞。

words.definition: 碼頭岸邊大型智慧橋式起重機

examples.en: Automated electric gantry cranes hoist forty-foot cargo containers from ship decks in ninety seconds.
examples.zh: 全自動電動橋式起重機僅需九十秒，即可俐落將四十呎標準貨櫃自萬噸巨輪甲板吊起。

examples.en: Port operators installed remote-controlled gantry systems to allow crane drivers to work safely from an office.
examples.zh: 港務營運商安裝了遠端遙控橋式起重機系統，讓起重機操作員能在辦公室內安全作業。

examples.en: Strong typhoon winds forced the terminal to lock down all gantry cranes to avoid structural damage.
examples.zh: 強烈颱風來襲的強風迫使碼頭鎖定所有橋式起重機，以避免結構性損壞。

words.definition: 港埠貨物裝卸承攬作業

examples.en: Smart port terminals deploy automated guided vehicles to streamline round-the-clock stevedoring tasks.
examples.zh: 智慧貨櫃碼頭導入無人搬運車，大幅加速了全天候二十四小時不間斷的港埠裝卸作業。

examples.en: Safety training is mandatory for all dock workers engaged in heavy maritime stevedoring operations.
examples.zh: 針對所有從事繁重海運碼頭裝卸作業的碼頭工人，工安培訓是強制性要求。

examples.en: The logistics company negotiated a new contract with the local stevedoring union to improve turnaround times.
examples.zh: 物流公司與當地碼頭裝卸工會協商了新合約，以提高船舶靠泊作業的周轉效率。

words.definition: 智慧冷鏈物流；後勤物流行程

examples.en: Temperature-controlled smart cold-chain logistics ensure premium Taiwanese mangoes arrive fresh in Japan.
examples.zh: 智慧溫控冷鏈物流確保台灣頂級愛文芒果在運抵日本東京各大超市時，依然維持鮮美多汁。

examples.en: Managing e-commerce logistics during double-eleven shopping festivals requires tremendous server capacity and warehouse staffing.
examples.zh: 在雙十一購物節期間處理電商物流，需要龐大的伺服器運算能力與充足的倉儲人力配置。

examples.en: Third-party logistics providers offer comprehensive warehousing, customs clearance, and last-mile delivery services.
examples.zh: 第三方物流業者提供涵蓋倉儲管理、報關檢驗及最後一哩路配送的整合性服務。

words.definition: 遠洋貨櫃商船；船艦；血管

examples.en: Ultra-large container vessels reduce fuel consumption per cargo unit through optimized hydrodynamic hulls.
examples.zh: 超大型貨櫃船透過流體力學最佳化船體設計，大幅降低單一貨櫃在遠洋航行中的平均燃油電耗。

examples.en: Naval patrol vessels escorted fishing boats through contentious waters to ensure maritime security.
examples.zh: 海軍巡邏艦艇護送漁船通過爭議水域，以維護海上作業安全。

examples.en: The research vessel returned to Kaohsiung harbor after collecting seabed sediment samples for two weeks.
examples.zh: 海洋研究船在採集了兩星期的海底沉積物樣本後，順利返抵高雄港。

words.definition: 現代數位航海導航；導航

examples.en: Electronic Chart Display and Information Systems (ECDIS) provide real-time GPS navigation through busy straits.
examples.zh: 電子海圖顯示與資訊系統在巨輪穿梭繁忙海峽時，提供毫秒級即時衛星航海導航。

examples.en: Heavy fog significantly impaired visual navigation, forcing the captain to rely entirely on marine radar.
examples.zh: 濃霧嚴重影響了肉眼目視導航，迫使船長完全仰賴航海雷達指引。

examples.en: Modern smartphones offer voice-guided navigation apps that help drivers navigate unfamiliar urban expressways.
examples.zh: 現代智慧型手機提供語音導航應用程式，協助駕駛人輕鬆行駛於陌生的市區快速道路。

words.definition: 港口引水人 (引航員)；領航

examples.en: Elite harbor pilots board incoming mega-vessels in rough seas to guide them safely into narrow berths.
examples.zh: 經驗老道的港口引水人頂著滔天風浪攀爬軟梯登輪，引領巨船安全進港停靠。

examples.en: She completed rigorous flight simulator training to earn her commercial airline pilot license.
examples.zh: 她完成了嚴格的飛行模擬器訓練，順利取得商用民航機飛行員執照。

examples.en: The government launched a pilot project in Chiayi to test autonomous electric shuttle buses in rural areas.
examples.zh: 政府在嘉義啟動了一項先導試驗計畫，測試偏鄉地區的自駕電動接駁公車。

words.definition: 港勤大馬力推頂拖船；拖船

examples.en: Powerful harbor tugboats push and pull the 400-meter vessel with pinpoint control during docking.
examples.zh: 數艘大馬力港勤拖船在巨輪兩側默契推頂與牽引，精準輔助長達四百公尺的巨輪側向靠泊。

examples.en: When the freighter lost propulsion power near the harbor mouth, two tugboats immediately rushed to tow it.
examples.zh: 當貨輪在港口出海口附近失去動力時，兩艘拖船立即趕往進行拖帶救援。

examples.en: Harbor tugboats are equipped with heavy-duty rubber fenders to cushion direct impacts against cargo ships.
examples.zh: 港勤拖船配備有厚重的橡膠防碰墊，以減緩與貨輪船體直接接觸時的撞擊力。

words.definition: 深水專用貨櫃泊位；停泊

examples.en: The newly opened Kaohsiung Seventh Terminal offers 18-meter deep berths accommodating the largest ships.
examples.zh: 高雄港第七貨櫃中心擁有水深達十八公尺的專用深水泊位，可供全球最大型貨櫃輪全天候靠泊。

examples.en: Passengers aboard overnight sleeper trains can reserve a comfortable lower bunk berth for resting.
examples.zh: 搭乘夜間臥鋪列車的旅客，可以預訂舒適的下鋪床位好好休息。

examples.en: The cruise ship was assigned a dedicated passenger berth right beside the historic Keelung harbor building.
examples.zh: 這艘豪華郵輪被分配到緊鄰基隆歷史港灣大樓的專屬客運碼頭泊位。

words.definition: 港區與主航道定期疏濬作業

examples.en: Regular fairway dredging prevents silt buildup, maintaining guaranteed channel depths for safe navigation.
examples.zh: 港務局定期調派大型抽砂疏濬船進行航道疏濬，確保主航道維持足夠水深以防巨船擱淺。

examples.en: Environmental groups monitored the dredging project near the estuary to prevent destruction of wetland habitats.
examples.zh: 環保團體密切監控河口附近的疏濬工程，防止濕地生態棲地遭受破壞。

examples.en: Sand obtained from harbor dredging is often processed and reused as fill material for coastal reclamation projects.
examples.zh: 從海港疏濬抽取的沙土常經處理後，被重新用作沿海填海造陸計畫的回填材料。

words.definition: 綠色低碳船舶燃料加注作業

examples.en: Asian ports expand green methanol and LNG bunkering facilities to supply environmentally friendly ships.
examples.zh: 亞洲各大主要樞紐港口加速興建綠色甲醇與液化天然氣船舶加注設施，供應零碳船舶。

examples.en: Shipowners schedule offshore bunkering during scheduled port stays to replenish maritime fuel reserves.
examples.zh: 船東在貨輪預定的靠港停泊期間安排海上加油作業，以補滿船舶燃料儲備。

examples.en: Port authorities implemented strict safety checklists to prevent petroleum leakages during ship bunkering operations.
examples.zh: 港口主管機關落實了嚴格的安全檢核表，以防在船隻加油作業過程中發生油品洩漏。

words.definition: 離岸外海海事工程的；在海上

examples.en: Installing massive foundations for offshore wind turbines demands specialized heavy-lift crane vessels.
examples.zh: 在外海海床打入巨大的離岸風力發電機水下基礎，極度考驗海事專用大型重吊施工船的離岸工程實力。

examples.en: Taiwan has rapidly emerged as a leading hub in the Asia-Pacific region for offshore wind farm development.
examples.zh: 台灣已迅速崛起為亞太地區離岸風力發電開發的關鍵樞紐。

examples.en: Financial institutions require comprehensive risk assessments before financing multi-billion-dollar offshore energy projects.
examples.zh: 金融機構在為數十億美元規模的離岸能源專案提供融資前，都會要求詳盡的風險評估。

words.definition: 智慧深海箱網水產養殖

examples.en: Typhoon-resistant submersible offshore aquaculture cages cultivate premium kingfish in crystal Penghu waters.
examples.zh: 引進抗強颱沈水式外海深海箱網水產養殖，在澎湖無污染海域中培育頂級生鮮海鱺。

examples.en: Inland freshwater aquaculture farmers in Tainan utilize automated water quality monitors to optimize milkfish health.
examples.zh: 台南內陸淡水水產養殖戶運用自動化水質監控設備，以最佳化虱目魚的生長健康。

examples.en: Sustainable aquaculture provides a vital source of protein while easing immense pressures on wild fishery stocks.
examples.zh: 永續水產養殖提供了重要的蛋白質來源，同時大幅減輕了野生漁業資源的耗損壓力。

words.definition: 澎湖優質箱網海鱺魚

examples.en: Fresh Taiwanese cobia is prized in international sashimi markets for its tender, rich white meat.
examples.zh: 台灣澎湖箱網養殖的新鮮海鱺魚，肉質細嫩鮮甜富含膠原蛋白，在國際生魚片市場享有盛譽。

examples.en: Local fishers cook cobia steaks in ginger broth to highlight the natural sweetness of the seafood.
examples.zh: 在地漁民常將海鱺魚厚切魚片入薑絲清湯熬煮，襯托出海味的自然鮮甜。

examples.en: Cage farmers carefully monitor feeding times to ensure healthy growth rates for captive cobia schools.
examples.zh: 箱網養殖戶謹慎監控投餵時程，以確保人工飼育的海鱺魚群擁有健康的成長速率。

words.definition: 大型海藻海帶（吸碳藍碳碳匯）

examples.en: Expanding coastal seaweed farming absorbs excess nitrogen runoff while sequestering carbon dioxide rapidly.
examples.zh: 大規模推廣沿海大型海藻海帶生態養殖，既能吸收農業氮肥餘量，又能快速固碳減碳。

examples.en: Dried roasted seaweed is a popular savory snack enjoyed by both children and adults in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 烘烤乾燥的海苔海藻是台灣大人小孩都非常喜愛的鹹香休閒零嘴。

examples.en: Marine biologists discovered that certain red seaweed varieties produce organic compounds useful in cosmetics.
examples.zh: 海洋生物學家發現某些紅藻海藻品種能產生可用於化妝品中的有機化合物。

words.definition: 沿海海水牡蠣浮筏養殖；海水養殖

examples.en: Sustainable oyster mariculture across southwestern Taiwan lagoons supports thousands of coastal fishing families.
examples.zh: 遍布台灣西南沿海潟湖的永續牡蠣浮筏海水養殖，支撐起數萬濱海漁家世代生計。

examples.en: Technological innovations in floating rafts have improved the storm resilience of modern coastal mariculture.
examples.zh: 浮筏結構的技術革新，顯著提升了現代沿海海水養殖抵禦風暴侵襲的韌性。

examples.en: Government researchers provide disease-resistant spat to help mariculture operators maintain consistent yields.
examples.zh: 政府研究機構提供抗病力強的優質苗種，協助海水養殖業者維持穩定的收成量。

words.definition: 人工魚礁聚魚設施；暗礁

examples.en: Sinking retired steel vessels creates sprawling artificial reefs that shelter millions of juvenile fish.
examples.zh: 將退役報廢的鋼鐵船隻投放沉入海底打造成人工魚礁，能成為百萬幼魚的避風港。

examples.en: Scuba divers travel from around the world to marvel at the vibrant coral reefs off Green Island and Orchid Island.
examples.zh: 來自世界各地的水肺潛水客專程前往綠島與蘭嶼，驚嘆於五彩繽紛的珊瑚礁生態。

examples.en: Rising ocean temperatures have triggered unprecedented coral reef bleaching events across tropical seas.
examples.zh: 海洋水溫持續攀升，引發了熱帶海洋中前所未有的珊瑚礁大規模白化現象。

words.definition: 海洋生態資源保護區；庇護所

examples.en: Marine sanctuaries establish strict no-take zones allowing damaged pelagic populations to recover.
examples.zh: 依法劃設國家級海洋保護區並落實核心禁漁，能讓遭受過度捕撈的近海魚群休養生息。

examples.en: The tranquil mountain temple served as a peaceful spiritual sanctuary away from bustling city stress.
examples.zh: 這座寧靜的山間古剎成為遠離繁忙都會壓力的心靈避風港庇護所。

examples.en: Rangers patrol the wildlife sanctuary day and night to protect endangered birds from illegal poaching.
examples.zh: 巡護員日夜在野生動物保護區內巡邏，保護瀕危鳥類免受非法盜獵侵害。

words.definition: 海巡署千噸級巡防艦巡弋執法

examples.en: Coast Guard cutters patrol Taiwan's Exclusive Economic Zone 24/7 to safeguard local fishing rights.
examples.zh: 海洋委員會海巡署巡防艦全天候三班巡弋專屬經濟海域，堅定捍衛台灣漁民海上作業權益。

examples.en: Police patrol cars cruised through the residential neighborhood to deter late-night burglaries.
examples.zh: 警用巡邏車在住宅社區周邊穿梭巡視，以嚇阻深夜可能發生的竊盜犯罪。

examples.en: Park rangers conduct regular walking patrols along slippery hiking trails after torrential afternoon downpours.
examples.zh: 午後暴雨過後，國家公園巡山員沿著濕滑的登山步道展開例行徒步巡邏。

words.definition: 岸際雷達與無人機全天候監控

examples.en: Coastal radar networks and long-range drone surveillance detect illegal smuggling boats in dark night waters.
examples.zh: 岸際高解析雷達網與長滯空無人機全天候監控，在漆黑深夜中精準辨識非法走私可疑船隻。

examples.en: The semiconductor foundry implemented high-resolution video surveillance to protect its intellectual property.
examples.zh: 半導體晶圓廠安裝了高解析度視訊監控系統，全力保護其核心智慧財產權。

examples.en: Public health authorities expanded genomic surveillance to track new respiratory virus mutations quickly.
examples.zh: 衛福與疾管機關擴大了基因定序監測網，以快速追蹤新型呼吸道病毒的變異情形。

words.definition: 保育類海洋鯨豚（鯨魚與海豚）

examples.en: Taiwan’s East Coast waters are a vital migration highway for over thirty species of majestic cetaceans.
examples.zh: 台灣東海岸花蓮與台東外海深邃的太平洋黑潮水域，是三十餘種珍貴保育類海洋鯨豚的洄游公路。

examples.en: Marine biologists record acoustic click patterns to study how cetaceans communicate across oceanic depths.
examples.zh: 海洋生物學家記錄聲波喀噠聲訊號，以研究深海鯨豚如何跨越浩瀚洋面進行溝通。

examples.en: Collisions with commercial vessels represent one of the most severe anthropogenic threats facing coastal cetaceans.
examples.zh: 與商用大型船隻發生碰撞，是沿岸海洋鯨豚所面臨最嚴重的人為威脅之一。

words.definition: 海龜與鯨豚岸際擱淺救援通報

examples.en: The volunteer marine stranding network rushed to rescue a sick green sea turtle washed ashore.
examples.zh: 全台海洋生物擱淺救援通報網絡在第一時間出動志工，緊急搶救被浪花沖上沙灘的病弱綠蠵龜。

examples.en: Prompt reporting of dolphin stranding incidents allows veterinary teams to deliver emergency medical triage.
examples.zh: 及早通報海豚擱淺事件，能讓獸醫團隊迅速抵達現場展開緊急醫療檢傷與救治。

examples.en: Researchers analyze tissue samples taken from deceased stranding animals to investigate potential pollutant levels.
examples.zh: 研究人員分析從擱淺死亡動物身上採集到的組織樣本，以調查潛在的環境污染物濃度。

words.definition: 澎湖與東沙環礁水下海草床

examples.en: Underwater seagrass meadows stabilize sandy seabeds and provide critical nursery grounds for seahorses.
examples.zh: 澎湖與東沙環礁清澈水下的茂密海草床，不僅能牢固底沙，更是海馬與小丑魚幼苗的溫床。

examples.en: Healthy seagrass beds trap floating particulate matter and improve overall coastal water transparency.
examples.zh: 健康繁茂的海草床能攔截水中漂浮的懸浮微粒，進而提升沿岸水質的整體清澈度。

examples.en: Coastal reclamation and heavy anchoring have degraded large swaths of historical seagrass beds in recent decades.
examples.zh: 近幾十年來，沿海填海工程與頻繁下錨作業已使大片歷史海草床遭受退化破壞。

words.definition: 海洋微塑膠微粒污染

examples.en: Microplastics floating across oceanic food webs accumulate in oysters and predatory pelagic tuna.
examples.zh: 漂浮在各大洋中的海洋微塑膠，正透過食物鏈悄悄累積於牡蠣與大型洄游黑鮪魚體內。

examples.en: Washing synthetic fleece garments releases thousands of tiny microplastics into municipal wastewater systems.
examples.zh: 清洗化纖刷毛衣物會將成千上萬個細微微塑膠纖維釋放到都會污水系統中。

examples.en: Environmental scientists are developing advanced biofilters capable of trapping microplastics before they reach rivers.
examples.zh: 環境科學家正在研發先進的生物濾芯，能在微塑膠流入河川水體之前將其有效攔截。

words.definition: 沉底廢棄幽靈刺網；鬼魂

examples.en: Volunteer diving teams cut loose deadly ghost fishing nets tangled around delicate coral heads.
examples.zh: 熱心環保潛水志工團隊手持專用潛水刀，深入海底割除並清除纏繞在脆弱珊瑚上的幽靈漁網。

examples.en: The old coal mining town in the hills slowly turned into an empty ghost town after the mines closed.
examples.zh: 在礦場關閉停產之後，山區這座昔日的採煤聚落逐漸變成了一座荒無人煙的鬼城。

examples.en: He had a ghost of a smile on his face as he remembered fond memories from his rural childhood.
examples.zh: 當他回憶起鄉村童年的美好溫馨往事時，嘴角不禁泛起了一絲若有若無的微笑。

words.definition: 海水淡化逆滲透技術 (RO)；反向

examples.en: Seawater reverse osmosis (SWRO) plants push high-pressure salty water through semi-permeable membranes.
examples.zh: 澎湖大型海水淡化逆滲透水廠在高壓下將海水推過半透膜，產出純淨清甜的民生自來水。

examples.en: The driver had to reverse the truck carefully through the narrow, crowded morning market alleyway.
examples.zh: 貨車司機必須小心翼翼地在人潮擁擠的狹窄早市巷弄中倒車。

examples.en: Switching to renewable power generation can help reverse alarming trends in urban carbon emissions.
examples.zh: 全面轉型採用再生能源發電，能有助於扭轉都市碳排放量持續攀升的令人擔憂趨勢。

words.definition: 黑潮深海低速洋流發電機渦輪

examples.en: Subsea current turbines harness the steady, perpetual flow of the Kuroshio to generate clean baseload electricity.
examples.zh: 沉浸在東海岸外海深處的黑潮水下渦輪發電機，日夜擷取奔騰洋流動能轉換為源源不絕的綠色基載電力。

examples.en: Offshore wind farm technicians ride specialized vessels to perform scheduled maintenance on wind turbine blades.
examples.zh: 離岸風場的專業技師搭乘特種運維船，定期登上高空對風力發電機葉片進行保養檢修。

examples.en: High-pressure steam spins the turbine rapidly inside thermal power plants to drive electric generators.
examples.zh: 火力發電廠內的高壓蒸氣高速推動渦輪機旋轉，帶動發電機源源不絕地產生電力。

words.definition: 龜山島海底火山熱泉硫磺噴口的

examples.en: Hydrothermal vents near Guishan Island discharge boiling mineral plumes supporting rare vent crab colonies.
examples.zh: 宜蘭外海龜山島周遭著名的海底火山熱泉終年噴發滾燙礦物硫磺，孕育出獨特怪村烏龜怪方蟹。

examples.en: Scientists study hydrothermal mineral chimneys to investigate early conditions under which microbial life originated.
examples.zh: 科學家藉由深入研究海底熱泉礦物噴口煙囪，探索地球早期微生物生命起源的環境條件。

examples.en: Submersible cameras captured mesmerizing milky plumes surging from active hydrothermal vents on the seafloor.
examples.zh: 深海潛水器鏡頭記錄下海底活躍熱泉噴口源源湧出如牛奶般白濁熱氣煙柱的迷人奇觀。

words.definition: 多音束高解析水深海底地形測繪

examples.en: Advanced multibeam sonar bathymetry maps underwater trenches, ridges, and submerged canyons in 3D.
examples.zh: 搭載先進多音束聲納的海洋研究船，精準繪製出台灣周邊海溝、海脊與深海大峽谷的高解析 3D 水深地形圖。

examples.en: Ocean engineers analyze seafloor bathymetry data to chart safe subsea telecommunication cable routes.
examples.zh: 海洋工程師詳盡分析海底地形水深測繪數據，以規劃最安全的跨國海底通訊電纜鋪設路由。

examples.en: Accurate bathymetry is crucial for predicting how destructive tsunami waves amplify as they approach shallow coasts.
examples.zh: 精準的水深測繪地形資料，對於精確模擬毀滅性海嘯波浪在逼近淺水海岸時的放大效應至關重要。

words.definition: 載人深海科學研究潛水器；可潛水的

examples.en: The scientific research submersible carried three geologists to explore deep-sea fault lines 3,000 meters down.
examples.zh: 這艘耐壓高達數百大氣壓的載人科學考察深潛器，載著三位地質學家深入三千公尺海底探索斷層帶。

examples.en: Deep-sea exploration relies on robotic submersible units equipped with high-definition cameras and robotic arms.
examples.zh: 深海探索高度仰賴裝載有高解析度鏡頭與機械夾爪的水下無人沉水探測器。

examples.en: Submersible water pumps are installed inside basement sumps to evacuate rainwater quickly during typhoons.
examples.zh: 大樓地下室的集水坑內安裝了沉水式抽水馬達，能在颱風豪雨期間迅速將雨水排出。

words.definition: 澎湖海域水下文化資產考古學

examples.en: Underwater archaeology teams catalog Ming and Qing dynasty porcelain cargo from sunken trade ships.
examples.zh: 專業水下文化資產考古團隊潛入澎湖黑水溝，細心測繪並打撈明清古代商船的沉船陶瓷遺物。

examples.en: She decided to major in archaeology after volunteering on a prehistoric excavation site in Taitung.
examples.zh: 在台東史前卑南文化遺址擔任考古發掘志工後，她毅然決定大學主修考古學。

examples.en: Ground-penetrating radar has revolutionized terrestrial archaeology by discovering buried ruins without destructive digging.
examples.zh: 透地雷達技術徹底革新了陸域考古學，讓研究人員無需進行破壞性挖掘即可探測地下遺跡。

words.definition: 蘭嶼達悟族傳統拼板舟 (Tatala)；獨木舟

examples.en: The Tao indigenous people carve and assemble ceremonial canoes from twenty-seven hand-hewn wooden planks.
examples.zh: 蘭嶼達悟族原住民族遵循祖先智慧，選用二十七塊精選深山原木手工雕鑿拼合出莊嚴華美的拼板舟。

examples.en: Tourists rented a lightweight tandem canoe to paddle lazily across the emerald waters of Sun Moon Lake.
examples.zh: 遊客租借了一艘輕巧的雙人獨木舟，悠閒地在日月潭碧綠清澈的湖面上隨意划行。

examples.en: Launching the sacred hand-crafted canoe into the surf requires strict adherence to ancestral tribal taboos.
examples.zh: 將神聖且耗費多年雕鑿的拼板舟推入浪花出海，必須嚴格遵守部落先祖流傳的傳統禁忌。

words.definition: 南島語族星象觀星跨洋航海辨位術

examples.en: Ancestral Austronesian wayfinding relied on navigating by star paths, ocean swells, and seabird flight directions.
examples.zh: 古老南島語族先民憑藉卓越的觀星尋路術，僅靠夜空星宿運轉軌跡與洋流海浪湧動即可橫渡浩瀚大洋。

examples.en: Modern hospital complexes install clear multilingual wayfinding signage to guide disoriented patients.
examples.zh: 現代大型醫療綜合體系設置了清晰的多語言尋路指引指標，引導迷路焦慮的病患。

examples.en: Traditional Polynesian wayfinding master navigators could traverse thousands of open ocean miles without instruments.
examples.zh: 傳統玻里尼西亞的尋路航海大師無需任何現代儀器，便能跨越數千浬遼闊浩瀚的茫茫大洋。

words.definition: 太平洋遠洋長波湧浪；膨脹

examples.en: Experienced traditional sailors detect hidden islands over the horizon by feeling changes in ocean swell patterns.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的航海大師閉上雙眼、赤腳踩在船底甲板上，僅憑海浪長波湧浪的微小拍打折射即可感應遠方島嶼。

examples.en: The heavy ocean swell caused by an approaching typhoon generated towering waves crashing against coastal sea walls.
examples.zh: 遠方接近的強烈颱風所掀起的巨大長浪湧浪，在沿海防波堤上拍擊出滔天的驚人巨浪。

examples.en: An ankle sprain can cause painful swelling if you do not apply ice promptly after the injury.
examples.zh: 扭傷腳踝如果在受傷後沒有及時冰敷，很容易造成局部劇烈疼痛與紅腫。

words.definition: 澎湖群島（九十座大小島嶼群）

examples.en: The breathtaking Penghu archipelago consists of ninety volcanic islands scattered across the Taiwan Strait.
examples.zh: 宛如散落在台灣海峽藍寶石海面上的澎湖群島，由九十座大大小小的火山玄武岩島嶼交織而成。

examples.en: Island-hopping flights and ferries connect the remote outer islands across the Matsu archipelago.
examples.zh: 跳島國內航班與交通客輪將馬祖列島各偏遠離島緊密串聯在一起。

examples.en: The Indonesian archipelago represents the largest island group in the world, spanning thousands of tropical isles.
examples.zh: 印尼群島是世界上幅員最遼闊的群島國家，橫跨數千座熱帶島嶼。

words.definition: 澎湖大菓葉壯麗柱狀玄武岩

examples.en: Towering columnar basalt cliffs formed millions of years ago when cooling volcanic lava cracked vertically.
examples.zh: 澎湖大菓葉壯麗雄偉的柱狀玄武岩石壁，是數百萬年前火山熔岩湧出地表冷卻結晶時垂直節理開裂的天然奇景。

examples.en: Geologists collected unweathered basalt samples from the cliff base to conduct radiocarbon dating.
examples.zh: 地質學家從玄武岩崖壁底部採集未風化的岩石標本，以進行放射性定年分析。

examples.en: The distinctive black basalt cobblestones give the old harbor promenade its unique historical charm.
examples.zh: 獨特黝黑的玄武岩鋪路石塊，賦予了老港區漫步海濱長廊別具一格的歷史風華。

words.definition: 澎湖七美雙心石滬捕魚石滬；矮壩

examples.en: The historic Twin-Heart Stone Weir traps schools of visiting fish during receding low tides naturally.
examples.zh: 澎湖七美享譽國際的雙心石滬，巧妙利用潮汐漲退落差，將游入滬房的魚群自然困在石堤之中。

examples.en: Local fishers maintained the intricate stone weir by replacing displaced boulders after winter storms.
examples.zh: 當地老漁民在冬季東北季風過後，會齊心協力修補並搬動巨石以維護石滬結構。

examples.en: The civil engineering department designed a low weir across the river to manage seasonal irrigation waters.
examples.zh: 水利工程部門在河川中游設計了一座低矮的石堰矮壩，以有效調度與調節各季度的農田灌溉水源。

words.definition: 花蓮友善賞鯨生態旅遊

examples.en: Sustainable marine eco-tourism educates tourists while keeping a respectful distance from wild dolphin pods.
examples.zh: 花蓮外海推廣的友善海洋生態旅遊，引導賞鯨船與野生海豚家族保持安全距離不打擾。

examples.en: Revenue generated from community eco-tourism helps fund local biodiversity conservation and trail maintenance.
examples.zh: 社區生態旅遊所創造的營收回饋，有助於資助當地的生物多樣性保育與登山步道日常修繕。

examples.en: Responsible eco-tourism operators ban disposable plastic bottles and single-use utensils on all guided boat trips.
examples.zh: 負責任的生態旅遊業者在所有導覽船程中全面禁用一次性塑膠瓶與免洗餐具。

words.definition: 全民向海致敬海洋守護管理責任

examples.en: Embracing responsible ocean stewardship means eliminating single-use plastics and preserving marine life.
examples.zh: 積極擁抱海洋守護管理責任使命，意味著從日常生活中徹底減塑，齊心守護蔚藍大海的萬物生靈。

examples.en: The indigenous community exercises faithful environmental stewardship over their ancestral mountain forests.
examples.zh: 原住民族部落對其世代傳承的祖靈山林領域，堅守著神聖且忠誠的環境守護責任。

examples.en: Corporate stewardship requires board directors to consider long-term environmental impacts alongside profits.
examples.zh: 健全的企業永續治理守護責任，要求董事會在追求商業獲利的同時，必須深思長遠的環境衝擊。

words.definition: 兼顧保育之永續海洋藍色繁榮

examples.en: A thriving blue economy generates sustainable coastal prosperity while regenerating damaged ocean habitats.
examples.zh: 蓬勃發展的海洋藍色經濟，在修復受損海洋生態棲地的同時，為濱海漁村注入源源不絕的永續綠色繁榮。

examples.en: Peace, economic stability, and educational opportunities are essential pillars for long-term national prosperity.
examples.zh: 和平安定、經濟穩健發展以及普及平等的教育機會，是國家長治久安與長遠繁榮的基石。

examples.en: The bustling night market brings lively economic prosperity to small food vendors and artisans alike.
examples.zh: 熱鬧喧囂的觀光夜市為廣大小吃攤商與在地手工藝創作者帶來了蓬勃的生機與商業繁榮。

words.definition: 海事港灣供應鏈抗災韌性

examples.en: Modern smart ports build infrastructural resilience against severe typhoons and rising sea levels.
examples.zh: 現代智慧商港全面強化防波堤與數位備援系統，構築起抵禦極端強烈颱風與氣候變遷的堅強港灣韌性。

examples.en: The local economy demonstrated remarkable resilience by recovering quickly after the major earthquake.
examples.zh: 當地經濟展現出令人驚豔的復原韌性，在歷經大地震後以極快的速度走出陰霾復興商機。

examples.en: Mental resilience helps young entrepreneurs stay determined and optimistic despite multiple venture failures.
examples.zh: 心理韌性有助於年輕創業者在歷經多次新創受挫後，依然能保持堅定意志與樂觀心態。

words.definition: 浩瀚神秘蔚藍海洋領域；王國

examples.en: Submarines dive thousands of meters beneath the waves to explore the alien, sunless oceanic realm.
examples.zh: 科考潛艇潛入海面數千公尺以下的無光深淵，探索宛如外星世界般神祕莫測的幽暗深海領域。

examples.en: The renowned physicist has made groundbreaking theoretical contributions to the realm of quantum optics.
examples.zh: 這位聲譽卓著的物理學泰斗，在量子光學領域做出了多項開創性的重要理論貢獻。

examples.en: The novel transports readers into an imaginative fantasy realm where dragons soar over enchanted castles.
examples.zh: 這部暢銷小說將讀者帶入一個天馬行空的奇幻王國領域，巨龍在受魔法守護的古堡上空盤旋翱翔。

words.definition: 駛向金色夕陽的無垠海平線

examples.en: Standing at the ship’s bow, travelers gaze at cargo vessels sailing toward the distant golden horizon.
examples.zh: 佇立在輪船船頭甲板上，迎著徐徐海風，眺望著一艘艘遠洋巨輪悠然駛向遠方海天一色的金色海平線。

examples.en: After months of grueling medical treatments, full recovery is finally on the horizon for the brave patient.
examples.zh: 經歷了數個月艱辛煎熬的醫療療程後，這位勇敢的病患終於盼來了即將完全康復的曙光。

examples.en: Moving to a new country and learning another foreign language will broaden your personal horizons immensely.
examples.zh: 移居到嶄新的國度生活並學習另一門外語，將會極大地開拓你的個人視野與心胸境界。

words.definition: 傳承百年的島嶼海洋文化遺產

examples.en: Preserving traditional shipbuilding crafts honors Taiwan’s deep, multifaceted island heritage.
examples.zh: 悉心傳承傳統手工木造造船工藝，是向台灣多元豐富、深厚悠久的島嶼海洋文化資產致上最高敬意。

examples.en: The historic temple with exquisite swallowtail roof ridges was officially designated a national heritage site.
examples.zh: 這座擁有精美燕尾飛簷古樸雕工的歷史古廟，被內政部正式核定為國定古蹟與文化遺產。

examples.en: Parents strive to pass down their native mother tongue and cultural heritage to future generations.
examples.zh: 家長竭盡所能將母語母體文化與民俗文化資產傳承給下一代，讓祖先的智慧薪火相傳。

words.definition: 與浩瀚太平洋大自然共生共榮

examples.en: Island communities flourish when they live in respectful harmony with oceanic tides and seasons.
examples.zh: 海島居民順應海洋潮汐起伏與季節洋流更替，在敬畏大自然的前提下活出和諧共生的生命智慧。

examples.en: The choir singers blended their melodic voices together in breathtaking four-part vocal harmony.
examples.zh: 合唱團團員將各自優美的嗓音完美融合在一起，展現出令人屏息動容的四部和聲天籟美感。

examples.en: Achieving work-life harmony requires setting clear boundaries between workplace duties and family evenings.
examples.zh: 實現工作與生活之間的平衡與和諧，需要在繁重職場職責與溫馨家庭時光之間設立清晰界線。

words.definition: 航向未知世界的跨洋偉大航程

examples.en: Every container ship embarking on a transpacific voyage carries the dreams of global trade.
examples.zh: 每一艘啟航展開橫跨太平洋萬里壯闊遠洋航程的萬噸貨輪，都承載著全球貿易互通的繁榮夢想。

examples.en: The early Portuguese sailors described Taiwan as Formosa during an epic sixteenth-century maritime voyage.
examples.zh: 早期葡萄牙航海家在十六世紀航經台灣海域的壯闊航程中，情不自禁讚嘆這座島嶼為福爾摩沙。

examples.en: Retirement marked the exciting beginning of a lifelong voyage filled with volunteer work and worldwide travels.
examples.zh: 光榮退休象徵著人生嶄新航程的精彩啟航，充滿了公益志工服務與環遊世界的無盡探索。

words.definition: 浩瀚無邊無際的蔚藍大海

examples.en: Gazing out at the boundless Pacific inspires boundless imagination, courage, and adventurous spirit.
examples.zh: 凝望著眼前這片浩瀚無垠、深邃湛藍的無邊大海，激發出我們內心無限的想像力、勇氣與冒險精神。

examples.en: The dedicated primary school teacher demonstrated boundless patience when helping struggling pupils learn math.
examples.zh: 這位滿懷熱忱的國小導師在輔導學習落後的學生算數學時，展現出無限無窮的無比耐心。

examples.en: Clean green energy and advanced technological innovations hold boundless potential for modern civilization.
examples.zh: 潔淨綠色能源與前瞻科技創新，蘊藏著引領現代人類文明邁向下一個高峰的無限潛能。
